governance: Adding a new color token, to either family, is a change-request event — not a per-diagram choice. Per-diagram choice is limited to which already-approved tokens get assigned to which sub-layers/pills (e.g. sample-3 legitimately collapsed 5 layer accents down to 3 without adding new colors).

standard.description: Extracted from the most battle-tested validated reference implementation so far.

navy.usage: the 'deployed on' wrapper box, not a sub-layer accent

mint.usage: Ingress/Egress gateway lanes, and reused (same values) by the 'viaEgress' semantic pill token below — deliberately, not a coincidence: a pill that cross-references the Egress lane should look like that lane, not an unrelated color. 'iconInner' (~70% brightness of 'border') is for the gateway icon specifically: it's a double concentric circle, not a single flat-color one — outer ring uses 'border', the smaller inner circle + its '+' use 'iconInner'. Pixel-measured independently from both arch-diagram-sample-1.png and arch-diagram-sample-2.png, landing on the same ratio both times.

softDivider.usage: fixed rendering constant, not a per-diagram choice: External Systems cluster box border AND the divider line between items within a multi-item cluster (same color for both). Pixel-sampled from arch-diagram-sample-1.png/-2.png, distinct from 'ink' and from any layer accent.

viaEgress.usage: the 'via egress' pill specifically — intentionally the SAME values as layerTokens.mint (not just 'comparable'), so this cross-reference pill visually matches the Egress lane it refers to. Corrected from an earlier draft that used an arbitrary unrelated slate-blue ('info', #3A4D6B/#E7ECF5) for this same pill — removed, no other current usage for a generic 'info' tag exists. If a genuinely generic (non-cross-referencing) informational pill is needed later, add it as its own named+justified token via the change-request process rather than reviving 'info'.

highlight.usage: e.g. the 'now' badge seen in arch-diagram-sample-3.png — value is a visual estimate, not extracted from a script; refine when a real asset is available

accessible.description: Colorblind/contrast-safe alternative family — secondary priority, not yet designed. Must map to the same sub-layer/semantic assignments as 'standard' (e.g. whatever sub-layer 'purple' represents here must have a corresponding accessible substitute at the same semantic slot) so a diagram regenerated in either family remains recognizable as the same architecture.
